data.title: Speeding fine (Bußgeldbescheid) – €98.50, 1 point
data.summary: The City of Musterau fines office issued a fine notice for driving 23 km/h over the limit on 2 September 2026. The total is €98.50 and 1 point in the driving-fitness register. It was formally delivered on 17 September 2026.
data.explanation: You are accused of speeding 23 km/h over the 70 km/h limit outside town. You can either accept the fine or file an objection (Einspruch) in writing or on record at the fines office. The app shows the objection deadline, which counts from the delivery date of 17 September 2026. Filing an objection can also lead to a less favourable decision. If you don't object, the notice becomes final and you must pay €98.50 within two weeks after that. Consider legal advice if you want to contest it.

items.title: File objection against fine notice

date.text: innerhalb von zwei Wochen nach Zustellung

items.quote: Dieser Bußgeldbescheid wird rechtskräftig und vollstreckbar, wenn Sie nicht innerhalb von zwei Wochen nach Zustellung schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der oben bezeichneten Verwaltungsbehörde Einspruch einlegen.
items.action: If you want to contest the fine, file an objection (Einspruch) in writing or on record with the fines office.
items.consequence: Otherwise the notice becomes final and enforceable.

items.title: Pay fine of €98.50
items.quote: Bitte zahlen Sie den Gesamtbetrag spätestens zwei Wochen nach Rechtskraft unter Angabe des Aktenzeichens auf das unten genannte Konto.
items.action: Pay the total of €98.50 to the account given, quoting the file number BG-2026-114502, within two weeks after the notice becomes final (Rechtskraft).
